scope: Pure bytes parser: preserve empty bfchar and bfrange-array destinations without shifted source codes; pad odd hex nibbles before atomic UTF16 validation. No new dependencies or public API changes.
rejected_attempts_retained: Initial full-workspace run mistakenly used converter SDK7961 for unchanged diff crate; exact same extraction binary passed all35 tests with pinned diff SDK8111. This is a controlled runtime proof, not full diff-suite qualification.
Diff-only rebuild failed for lack of disk before tests; not counted as product regression or pass. Completed targets were cleaned after frozen artifact hashes were checked.
Initial OCR-ONNX offline attempt failed to link ONNX Runtime. Same locked source/feature target rerun with normal dependency acquisition enabled passed full suite; no code or oracle changes.
Original truncating-UTF16 legacy property was corrected to require whole decoded UTF16 validity, preserving complete input compatibility and valid odd-nibble padding.
failures_retained: Production readiness remains false: GNU Hello font substitution, overflow and pagination failures remain; Type1 font-embedding and narrow-gutter branches are not included.
SF52 opaque glyphs and SF1199A complex forms remain rejected; English outlined text, Japanese image pagination and Fukui layout remain unaccepted.
This scoped change does not add hex-string whitespace or multiline support, or fix the pre-existing scalar bfrange UTF16 destination implementation. These require separate spec-grounded tests.
Empty logical ToUnicode preserves source text semantics; these checks do not establish glyph appearance fidelity or Word rendering. Strict mode is not a proof of full fidelity.
